reason: The README explicitly describes this repository as a community-maintained, categorized directory for browsing and discovering DeepSeek Harness plugins, with repository links, installation commands, and machine-readable index data; it has no runtime functionality.

summaries.zh: 按类别整理 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，提供搜索浏览、仓库链接、安装命令和机器可读索引。
summaries.en: A categorized directory for discovering DeepSeek Harness community plugins through searchable listings, repository links, installation commands, and machine-readable index data.
